The '''Battle of Gaerboud IV''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that commenced when Rebel snubfighters attempted to interdict the deployment of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s from the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Sentinel (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|''Sentinel'']] to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Dauntless'']].

==The Battle==
A force of Rebel Alliance [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] led by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] emerged from hyperspace near [[Gaerboud IV]] and proceeded to attack TIE/ad starfighters, or TIE Avengers, as they were ferried by unskilled workers from the ''Sentinel'' to the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Dauntless'', which was on-site to take stock of a new order of the elite craft.

The ''Dauntless'' immediately deployed [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]] to meet the Rebel threat. These escort fighters proved far more of a threat to the X-wings than did the TIE Avengers, which were barely capable of jinking to avoid starfighter attack. As in the previous two battles of [[Operation: Quick Strike]], a small number of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] were available to provide support to the Rebel squadrons if needed. For the Galactic Empire, a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] remained on standby.

However, should enough TIE Avengers manage to enter the hangar bay of The ''Dauntless'', the Rebels would, in a possible attempt at desperation would send in a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] called the [[Rehz'nor]] which would launch X-wings and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y- wings]] which would commence torpedo runs on the ''Dauntless'' in an attempt to destroy it.

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Interdiction of Starfighter Deployment" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side&mdash;both sides have conflicting mission objectives&mdash;and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle Operation: Quick Strike, using the default craft assigned to the player.
